entry.name: mc.vectral~
entry.description: Use the vectral~ object to filter frame-based signal data such as the output of the fft~ object.

arguments.name: vector-size
arguments.description: The argument is the vector size for the operation. It defaults to 512, but should be set appropriately for the size of the vectors you feed into theobject.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears object's sample memory (in case of a blow-up).

messages.name: deltaclip
messages.digest: Limit the change in bins of successive vectors to a value range
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by two floats, limits the change in bins of successive vectors to the values given. This is equivalent to the time-domainobject.

messages.name: rampsmooth
messages.digest: Perform linear vector smoothing across successive frames
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by two ints, causes the vector to be smoothed in a linear fashion across successive frames. The arguments specify the number of frames to use to interpolate values in both directions. This is equivalent to the time-domain filtering done by theobject.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: A sync signal for the index of the output vector. This is typically in the range of 0 to n-1 (where n is the size of the vector).In middle inlet: A sync signal received in the middle inlet is used to synchronize the input index of the vector being processed. The sync signal will typically be in the range 0 to n-1 (where n is the size of the vector). If the left and middle inlets are "out-of-sync", the incoming vector's bins will shift by the difference between the two signals.In right inlet: Signal data to be filtered. This will usually be frequency-domain information such as the output of anorobject.

messages.name: size
messages.digest: Set the vector size for the operation
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the vector size for the operation. The default is 512.

messages.name: slide
messages.digest: Perform log vector interpolations across successive frames (like)
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by two floats, causesto do logarithmic interpolation of successive vectors in a manner equivalent to the time-domainobject. The two arguments determine the denominator coefficient for the amount of the slide.
